title: Which coordination machinery belongs outside the base Workbench?
question: Which coordination machinery belongs outside the base Workbench?
answer:
V3-5: FUIDs, Job Orders, flights, Claims, Journal/CAS, Halls, sockets, Captain, CIC, scheduling and runtime visibility remain Foundry augmentation.
V3-24: Make LLM Workbench good enough, current, and safely reusable in other projects while Foundry finishes; do not redesign it into Foundry or expand optional architecture.
V3-24B: Broad guidebook taxonomy, Foundry runtime concepts, orchestration, generalized plugin/catalog architecture, unrelated pending skills, and aesthetic refactors.
FND-Q17e: A coordinator comes later; first prove single-Task execution: "There should be a coordinator, but that will be built in a little bit. Right now let's just prove that we can execute a task every single time consistently." Backlog after v4.
WF-10: 'Its more B': there should be a coordinator, but it will be built later. 'Right now let's just prove that we can execute a task every single time consistently.' Future capabilities are planned on the Blueprint; not every Spec is built now.

confirmation.basis: Each source answer was owner-settled in its grilling session, per the grilling ledger at 56b459da: V3-5, V3-24, V3-24B, WF-10 (locked); FND-Q17e (deferred, settled as later work). The card's grouping, title and synthesis are agent work (2026-09-26 draft grouping and the 2026-10-01 ledger backfill), not separately owner-confirmed.
